name: [Portal] Professional category domain layer (BE)
description:
### Summary

CZ3TDR1-674 builds the read/write model for the `partner` record itself, but categories (`partner_category`/`partner_category_lng`/`partner_category_rel`) are a separate aggregate with their own contract endpoint (`GET /categories/professionals`) and count semantics ("Published items" per category). No task currently owns this.

### Why?

Without a category domain layer, the professionals-landing page and category filter have no real data source, and the "primary category vs. additional categories" shape (`ProfessionalSummary.category` singular + `.categories` array) used throughout the contract has nowhere to be decided.

### What?

A CQRS read model in `cms/packages/PartnerPortal` returning `professionals` taxonomy categories with per-language name/title/description/iconSlug and a published-partner count, plus commands to create/update a category and to set a partner's categories (primary + additional).

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Query: `GET /categories/professionals` semantics — list with `count` = published (`partner.status = publish`) partners referencing that category via `partner_category_rel`
- [ ] Command: create/update a `partner_category` + its per-language rows, including `iconSlug` (added by CZ3TDR1-713)
- [ ] Command: set a partner's categories (one primary + additional), enforced against whatever cardinality the admin edit screen exposes
- [ ] Unit + integration tests; PHPStan level 10
- [ ] Follows the `cms/packages/Marketplaces` layering (Application/Domain/Infrastructure/Presentation) established for this package by CZ3TDR1-542

### Resources

- Epic: CZ3TDR1-614
- Depends on: CZ3TDR1-572, CZ3TDR1-713 (`iconSlug` column)
- Feeds: the public-API and admin-CRUD tasks filed alongside this one
